note: Fake executive assistant job requiring gift card purchases.
text: Good day, I am Dr. Helen Voss, CEO of Lumen Ridge Capital. I need a personal assistant for urgent tasks while I am in meetings. Your first task: buy five $100 Apple gift cards, scratch the backs, and send me the codes by text. You will be repaid plus a $200 bonus. Keep this confidential.
